grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: A New Evening Class
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和题目都是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先读文章，再做题。答案必须来自文章。
passage:
Li Wei is a nurse in Nanjing. She works long hours. Last year, she wanted to learn English. She started an evening class in September. She has studied English for eight months. She has already finished two books. Her teacher is Mr. Chen. He has taught English since 2010. He has taught at this school for six years.

Li Wei has a busy life. She has not missed a class yet. She has already made three friends in the class. They meet after class for coffee. Last week, they went to a bookstore together. Li Wei bought a small dictionary. She has used it every day since then. She has also joined an English club. The club meets on Saturday mornings. She has been a member for two months. She has already spoken to many people there. She has not given a speech yet. She wants to try next month.

Mr. Chen gives homework every week. Li Wei has just finished her homework for this week. She has not checked her answers yet. She will check them tomorrow. Last month, she took a practice test. She got 65 points. She has improved her score since then. Now she can get 75 points. She has also started to read English news online. She has read five short articles so far. She finds them difficult but interesting.

Li Wei wants to visit London one day. She has never travelled outside China. She has saved some money for a trip. She has not booked a ticket yet. She says, “I have learned a lot this year. I am happy.”

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去发生的事对现在有影响，或者从过去持续到现在。结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还”或“已经”。since 后面接时间点（如 since 2010），for 后面接一段时间（如 for eight months）。一般过去时只说明过去某个时间发生的事，不强调对现在的影响，常与 last week、last month 等连用。
grammar.example: She has studied English for eight months. (现在完成时，持续到现在) Last week, they went to a bookstore together. (一般过去时，过去的具体时间)

options: She has already finished her homework.
She has already finish her homework.
She already has finished her homework.
answers: She has already finished her homework.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时的结构是 has + 过去分词，already 放在 has 和过去分词之间。
questions.evidence: She has already finished two books.

questions.explanation: since 后面接时间点（2010），现在完成时表示从2010年持续到现在。

options: She has not checked her answers yet.
She has not checked her answers already.
She did not checked her answers yet.
She has not check her answers yet.
answers: She has not checked her answers yet.
questions.explanation: yet 用于否定句末尾，表示“还（没）”。现在完成时否定结构是 has not + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: She has not checked her answers yet.

options: Last week, they went to a bookstore together.
Last week, they have gone to a bookstore together.
Last week, they have went to a bookstore together.
Last week, they go to a bookstore together.
answers: Last week, they went to a bookstore together.
questions.explanation: last week 是过去的具体时间，用一般过去时 went，不用现在完成时。
questions.evidence: Last week, they went to a bookstore together.
